description: Compare a candidate playlist with a golden checklist's golden playlist, line by line. The golden set is a small list of checklists. A checklist in it gets its golden playlist, its reference, only when a person confirms one through playlist_review with reviewer_type human; until then the answer says no golden playlist is held for the checklist yet, and nothing is compared. Give checklist_id, one in the golden set, and playlist_id, the candidate: a playlist of the same checklist, as playlist_save returned it. For each line of the golden playlist the answer says whether the candidate has a line that matches it in kind, credits and courses, or how the candidate's line differs, or that the candidate has none; and it lists the candidate's lines the golden playlist does not have. Give against_playlist_id as well to compare the candidate with that saved playlist of the same checklist instead, on kind, credits, courses, designation and fills_from; the checklist then need not be in the golden set, and agrees says whether every line does. Read-only.

against_playlist_id.description: Optional: a saved playlist of the same checklist, or a kept candidate, to compare the candidate with, in place of the golden playlist

checklist_id.description: A checklist in the golden set

playlist_id.description: The candidate playlist's playlist_id, or the candidate_id of a build that playlist_save kept as a candidate

name: playlist_compare
title: Playlist Compare
